resources.string: Enter a whole pixel dimension from 1 to 1,000,000, without separators.
Enter 0.01 to 10,000 with at most two decimal places, using a decimal point.
Ratio-only needs just the source dimensions. Other methods show only their required inputs. Inactive target drafts are kept while switching methods, but are not included in saved snapshots.

Calculates an ideal scale from the source ratio. Width, height and percentage modes round pixels to nearest, with halves up. Fit rounds down so it never exceeds the box; Fill rounds up so it covers the box. Integer rounding can slightly change the final pixel ratio. Zero-pixel or over-limit results are rejected.

Sizing arithmetic only: no image is opened, uploaded, resized or cropped. Fit assumes a padded canvas and Fill assumes a centered crop. An odd extra pixel is assigned to the right or bottom. No resampling quality, print DPI or physical size is calculated.
Explicit imports restore inputs only; press Calculate size. Remember results can reconstruct a completed sizing calculation. Saved modes retain only the sizing method.
Reduced source ratio: %1$d:%2$d\nResized dimensions: %3$d × %4$d pixels\nIdeal scale: %5$s%% (%6$d ÷ %7$d)
Fit canvas: %1$d × %2$d pixels\nPadding: left %3$d, right %4$d, top %5$d, bottom %6$d pixels
Fill crop box: %1$d × %2$d pixels\nCrop from resized image: left %3$d, right %4$d, top %5$d, bottom %6$d pixels
Enter source dimensions and a sizing method, then calculate.
Rounded output must be between 1 and 1,000,000 pixels on each side. Change the target dimensions or scale.
The saved sizing setup is invalid. Your current inputs were kept.
